properties.text: THE TOWER CRANE AND ITS LOAD-MOMENT CONTROLLER.  The two knobs are the operator: LOAD m puts tonnes on the hook, REACH r asks for the trolley to run out along the jib.  The three calculators between them and the figure are the crane's controller, one decision each.  LOAD CHART: the furthest this load may go, rmax -- how far the 12 t counterweight can balance it with its trolley right at the end of its 4..15 m track.  REACH LIMITER: the reach actually allowed, r cut back to rmax.  COUNTERWEIGHT: where the counterweight must stand so the moments about the mast cancel (crane data in each: trolley and hook 0.5 t, jib steel 3 t at 22 m, counter-jib steel 1.5 t at 7 m).  The figure takes all five numbers on five named inputs and decides nothing; it only checks the balance, printing both moments side by side.  Wind either knob and the counterweight slides to meet it: the moments stay equal and the cab lamp stays green.  Until the counterweight reaches its stop -- then the limiter refuses the rest of the reach.  The trolley halts at the red mark on the jib (rmax, which walks in as the load grows), the reach asked for stays behind as a dotted ghost, and the lamp turns red.  The crane is never out of balance; only the operator's wish is.

properties.expression:
m = value
M = 12
mt = 0.5
Wj = 3
Wc = 1.5
xmax = 15

rmax = (M * xmax + Wc * 7 - Wj * 22) / (m + mt)

rmin = 6
rtip = 42

reach = clamp(r, rmin, min(rmax, rtip))

M = 12
mt = 0.5
Wj = 3
Wc = 1.5
xmin = 4
xmax = 15

x = clamp(((m + mt) * reach + Wj * 22 - Wc * 7) / M, xmin, xmax)

properties.program:
# THE TOWER CRANE AND ITS LOAD-MOMENT CONTROLLER
#
# Five inputs, one per wire: what the operator asks for, m and r, straight
# from the knobs; and what the controller answers -- rmax, the furthest
# this load may go (the Load chart), reach, the part of r it allowed (the
# Reach limiter), and x, where it put the counterweight (Counterweight).
# The figure decides nothing.  It draws those five numbers, and it checks
# the balance itself: the two moments below are worked out here, from
# the same crane data the controller used, and printed side by side.

# --- the crane, in tonnes and metres (the controller's data, repeated) ----
M    = 12      # the counterweight
mt   = 0.5     # the load trolley and the hook block
Wj   = 3       # the jib's own steel, centred 22 m out
Wc   = 1.5     # the counter-jib's steel, centred 7 m back
xmin = 4       # the counterweight's track, metres behind the mast
xmax = 15
rtip = 42      # the end of the trolley's track

limited = r > reach + 0.01
Mfront  = (m + mt) * reach + Wj * 22
Mback   = M * x + Wc * 7

view -20, -3, 46, 46.5
align "centre", "middle"

# --- the geometry, in metres ----------------------------------------------
J  = 24        # the jib's top chord
B  = J - 2     # its bottom chord, where the trolley runs, at the mast
H  = 14.5       # the hook's height
T  = 0.6       # arrows: units per tonne, one scale for both weights

# --- the ground and the footing ------------------------------------------
color "#202020"
width 0.5
line -20, 0, 46, 0
width 0.25
repeat 22
  line -19 + 3 * i, 0, -20 + 3 * i, -1.2
end
fill "#d8d4cc"
rect -4, -2, 8, 2
nofill

# --- the mast, a lattice of panels ---------------------------------------
color "#b8860b"
width 0.45
line -1.2, 0, -1.2, B
line  1.2, 0,  1.2, B
width 0.25
repeat 8
  line -1.2, B / 8 * i, 1.2, B / 8 * (i + 1)
end

# --- the jib and the counter-jib, and the apex that ties them -------------
width 0.45
line 0, J, rtip + 1, J
line 0, B, rtip + 2, B + 0.8
line rtip + 1, J, rtip + 2, B + 0.8
line -17, J, 0, J
line -17, J - 1.5, 0, J - 1.5
line -17, J, -17, J - 1.5
width 0.25
repeat 21
  line 2 * i, B + 0.8 * i / 21, 2 * i + 2, J
end
repeat 8
  line -2 * i, J - 1.5, -2 * i - 2, J
end
width 0.45
line -1.2, B, -1.2, J + 6
line  1.2, B,  1.2, J + 6
line -1.2, J + 6, 1.2, J + 6
width 0.3
line 0, J + 6, 30, J
line 0, J + 6, -16, J

# the cab, and its lamp: green while the crane balances as asked, red
# when the controller had to refuse part of the reach
color "#202020"
width 0.3
fill "#e8e4da"
rect 1.2, B - 2.6, 3.2, 2.6
fill "#2e8b57"
circle 2.8, B - 1.3, 0.6
fill "#c0392b"
circle 2.8 / limited, B - 1.3, 0.6
nofill

# --- the counterweight's track, and the stop at its far end ---------------
color "#606060"
width 0.35
line -xmin, J - 2.2, -xmax, J - 2.2
fill "#606060"
rect -xmax - 0.8, J - 2.8, 0.6, 1.3
fill "#c0392b"
rect (-xmax - 0.8) / limited, J - 2.8, 0.6, 1.3
nofill

# --- the counterweight, hanging from its trolley under the counter-jib ----
color "#202020"
width 0.3
line -x, J - 1.5, -x, J - 2.6
fill "#9c9a94"
rect -x - 2, J - 8, 4, 5.4
nofill
color "#f4efe6"
font 1.9
text -x, J - 5.3, "%.0f t", M

# --- the ghost of the reach the operator asked for, when it was refused ---
rg = r / limited
color "#c0392b"
width 0.3
dash "dot"
line rg, B, rg, H
circle rg, H - 0.6, 0.6
dash "solid"

# --- the load trolley, the hook and the load --------------------------------
yt = B + 0.8 * reach / (rtip + 2)
color "#202020"
width 0.3
fill "#606060"
rect reach - 1, yt - 0.8, 2, 0.8
nofill
line reach, yt - 0.8, reach, H
fill "#606060"
circle reach, H - 0.6, 0.6
nofill
s = 2.2 * cbrt(m)
line reach, H - 1.2, reach, H - 2
fill "#5b4a3a"
rect reach - s / 2, H - 2 - s, s, s
nofill

# the furthest this load may go, marked on the jib in the readout's red
rf = rmax / (rmax < rtip)
color "#c0392b"
width 0.6
line rf, B - 1, rf, J + 1

# --- the two weights, drawn to one scale ------------------------------------
ah = 1.2
aw = 0.7
yl = H - 2.6 - s
yc = J - 8.6
color "#3a5a9b"
fill  "#3a5a9b"
width 0.45
line reach, yl, reach, yl - T * (m + 0.5) + ah
poly reach, yl - T * (m + 0.5), reach - aw, yl - T * (m + 0.5) + ah,
     reach + aw, yl - T * (m + 0.5) + ah
line -x, yc, -x, yc - T * M + ah
poly -x, yc - T * M, -x - aw, yc - T * M + ah, -x + aw, yc - T * M + ah
nofill

# ======================================================================
#  THE READOUT
# ======================================================================
color "#202020"
font 2.4
align "right", "top"
text 45, 45.5, "load  m = %.1f t     reach = %.1f m", m, reach
text 45, 42.5, "counterweight  x = %.1f m back", x
text 45, 39.5, "moments  %.0f t·m = %.0f t·m", Mfront, Mback
color "#c0392b"
text 45 / (rmax < rtip), 36.5, "most reach for this load  %.1f m", rmax
text 45 / limited, 33.5, "asked for %.1f m -- refused", r
